# v1.1.0-dev.126: A profile that can't be read says so

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.125`. One fix,
for a report where a profile seemed to vanish after a hotkey load.

## What happened

A profile file that can't be read (empty, or no longer valid JSON) was
left out of the list with no word why. Saving the same name again then
wrote a fresh profile from the desk as it was: no hotkey, no display
settings, none of the window edits. Loading it reported every window
restored, because every window was already where it had just been
captured. All of that was still on disk in the profile's history file.
Nothing read it.

## What changed

- The list shows a row under the profiles for any file it couldn't
  read, naming the file. Click it to open the folder.
- When you save a name whose file is there but unreadable, the prompt
  says that, instead of "already exists".
- Saving over an unreadable or deleted profile carries the hotkey,
  display settings, post-load command and window edits over from the
  newest entry in its history, and the status bar says it did. A profile
  you deleted in the app and save again still starts clean.

If this already happened to you: open the re-saved profile, open
History, and restore the version from before. Everything is there.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
